SELECT HOUSE_CODE , CONT_NO , CONT_GL_SEQ , SIGNER_NO , ADD_DATE , ADD_TIME , ADD_USER_ID , CHANGE_DATE , CHANGE_TIME , CHANGE_USER_ID , SEQ , SIGNER_ID , SIGNER_NAME , SIGNER_EMAIL , SIGNER_PHONE , SIGNER_COMPANY_CODE , SIGNER_COMPANY_NAME , SIGNER_COMPANY_OWNER , SIGNER_COMPANY_ADDR , SIGN_FLAG , SIGN_TYPE , SIGN_KEY , SIGN_FIX_HTML , SIGN_COMMENT
, SIGN_VALUE , SIGN_ORG_VALUE , CERT_INFO
, LINK FROM SSIGN WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND CONT_NO = ${CONT_NO} AND CONT_GL_SEQ = ${CONT_GL_SEQ} AND SIGNER_NO = $S{SIGNER_NO} AND SEQ = $S{SEQ} AND SIGNER_ID = $S{SIGNER_ID} AND SIGNER_COMPANY_CODE = $S{SIGNER_COMPANY_CODE} AND SIGN_FLAG = $S{SIGN_FLAG} ORDER BY SEQ

UPDATE SSIGN SET CHANGE_DATE = ${current.DATE} , CHANGE_TIME = ${current.TIME} , CHANGE_USER_ID = ${session.ID} , SEQ = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${SEQ} , SEQ) , SIGNER_ID = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${SIGNER_ID} , SIGNER_ID) , SIGNER_NAME = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${SIGNER_NAME} , SIGNER_NAME) , SIGNER_EMAIL = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${SIGNER_EMAIL} , SIGNER_EMAIL) , SIGNER_PHONE = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${SIGNER_PHONE} , SIGNER_PHONE) , SIGNER_COMPANY_CODE = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${SIGNER_COMPANY_CODE} , SIGNER_COMPANY_CODE) , SIGNER_COMPANY_NAME = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${SIGNER_COMPANY_NAME} , SIGNER_COMPANY_NAME) , SIGNER_COMPANY_OWNER = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${SIGNER_COMPANY_OWNER}, SIGNER_COMPANY_OWNER) , SIGNER_COMPANY_ADDR = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${SIGNER_COMPANY_ADDR} , SIGNER_COMPANY_ADDR) , SIGN_FLAG = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${SIGN_FLAG} , SIGN_FLAG) , SIGN_TYPE = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${SIGN_TYPE} , SIGN_TYPE) , SIGN_KEY = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${SIGN_KEY} , SIGN_KEY) , SIGN_VALUE = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${SIGN_VALUE} , SIGN_VALUE) , SIGN_ORG_VALUE = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${SIGN_ORG_VALUE} , SIGN_ORG_VALUE) , CERT_INFO = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${CERT_INFO} , CERT_INFO) , SIGN_COMMENT = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${SIGN_COMMENT} , SIGN_COMMENT) , SIGN_FIX_HTML = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${SIGN_FIX_HTML} , SIGN_FIX_HTML) , LINK = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${LINK} , LINK) WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND CONT_NO = ${CONT_NO} AND CONT_GL_SEQ = ${CONT_GL_SEQ} AND SIGNER_NO = ${SIGNER_NO}

SELECT HOUSE_CODE , CONT_NO , CONT_GL_SEQ , SEQ , REVIEWER_NO , ADD_DATE , ADD_TIME , ADD_USER_ID , CHANGE_DATE , CHANGE_TIME , CHANGE_USER_ID , REVIEW_SEQ , REVIEWER_ID , REVIEWER_NAME , REVIEWER_EMAIL , REVIEWER_PHONE , REVIEWER_COMPANY_CODE , REVIEWER_COMPANY_NAME , REVIEWER_COMPANY_OWNER , REVIEWER_COMPANY_ADDR , REVIEW_FLAG , REVIEW_COMMENT , LINK FROM SCTRV WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND CONT_NO = ${CONT_NO} AND CONT_GL_SEQ = ${CONT_GL_SEQ} AND SEQ = $S{SEQ} AND REVIEWER_NO = $S{REVIEWER_NO} AND REVIEW_SEQ = $S{REVIEW_SEQ} AND REVIEWER_ID = $S{REVIEWER_ID} AND REVIEWER_COMPANY_CODE = $S{REVIEWER_COMPANY_CODE} AND REVIEW_FLAG = $S{REVIEW_FLAG} ORDER BY SEQ
